scripts.build: tsc --build && babel ./dist/agent.js --out-dir ./dist --out-file-extension .compiled.js --plugins @guildai/babel-plugin-agent-compiler && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('.')) if (f.endsWith('.md')) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f);"
scripts.clean: tsc --build --clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['dist','node_modules','package-lock.json']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});"
